d:
When the calls get chaotic, Ernie Brown Jr. and Neal James must keep their cool! From unpredictable wildlife encounters to tricky animal rescue missions, the duo faces situations that can spiral out of control in seconds. Every call brings a new challenge, testing their instincts, patience and ability to handle creatures that refuse to cooperate.
As Turtleman and Neal tackle difficult wildlife rescue and wild animal capture jobs, can they turn these chaotic encounters into successful rescues?
